The page URL (chase-secure-account.net) and the screenshot indicate a phishing page impersonating Chase. Per privacy and safety guidelines, I will not interact with the suspicious site or enter any sensitive information. I navigated to the official Chase site so you can sign in safely if needed. Recommended next steps: 1) Do NOT click any 'Verify' or similar links on the suspicious site or the email. 2) From a new browser tab, sign in only at chase.com (I opened it). 3) From the official site or Chase app, immediately change your password and enable MFA. 4) Contact Chase using the phone number on the back of your card or the contact info on chase.com to report the suspicious sign-in and confirm account status. 5) Monitor recent transactions and consider freezing account or requesting a new card if you see unauthorized activity. 6) Report the phishing email to Gmail (Report phishing) and to Chase at phishing@chase.com or via their fraud reporting methods. 7) Consider running a malware scan on your device and updating passwords for any accounts that share credentials. If you want, I can open a new tab to Gmail to report the message and then sign in at chase.com to guide you through secure steps — tell me how you'd like to proceed.
